raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

The Mamba/SSM mixers (`MambaMixer2`, `MambaMixer`, `ShortConv`) re-derived their
`conv_state` view from `self.kv_cache[0]` on every forward: in the default SD
layout this is a `transpose(-1, -2)` to give the conv kernels a
`(..., dim, state_len)` view. The view depends only on the cache tensor
storage/strides, fixed once allocated, so deriving it per call is pure host
overhead that multiplies by `num_mamba_layers × tokens`. The mixer forward runs
inside a `direct_register_custom_op` (dispatched via `no_compile_layers`), so it
is opaque to `torch.compile` and executes eagerly even under the default
compiled regime — exactly the per-call view-derivation class of #59534 / #64572,
in a different subsystem (Mamba/SSM, not attention).

Add `get_conv_state_view` in `mamba_utils`, caching the view per cache-tensor
identity (mirroring the FlashAttention fix #64571), and clear it in
`clear_layer_kv_caches` so the detached profiling state cache is not pinned. The
identity check rebuilds the view when the profiling cache is replaced by the
real one.

Related: #59534, #64571, #64572

## Testing

`pytest tests/kernels/mamba/test_conv_state_view_cache.py` — 4 passed (CPU-only):
SD layout caches the transpose and hits on the same tensor, the cache rebuilds
when the tensor is replaced, an in-place write through the view aliases the base
storage, and the DS layout returns the base tensor unchanged (no copy).

Host time per `transpose(-1, -2)` vs a cached-view hit (CPU, N=20000 after
warmup, blocks=2000/state_len=4/dim=2048): **1.75 µs → 0.21 µs/call**, ×
num_mamba_layers × tokens. `pre-commit` clean (ruff, ruff-format, mypy).

## Duplicate check

`gh pr list --state open --search "conv_state transpose ..."` and
`"mamba conv_state cache"`: no matching open PR. Open Mamba PRs concern
checkpointing, prefill batching, and CUDA-graph/metadata — none touch the
per-call conv_state view derivation.

---
I used an AI coding assistant to help investigate and implement this change; I
reviewed and verified it (tests + microbench + pre-commit above) and take
responsibility for the contents.

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CPU-only regression tests for the Mamba conv-state view cache (#64572)."""
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba import mamba_utils
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import get_conv_state_view
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
+
+
+def _base() -> torch.Tensor:
+    # (num_blocks, state_len, dim) in the default SD layout.
+    return torch.randn(8, 4, 16)
+
+
+def test_sd_layout_caches_transpose_and_hits():
+    base = _base()
+    cache, conv_state = get_conv_state_view(None, base)
+    assert cache[0] is base
+    assert torch.equal(conv_state, base.transpose(-1, -2))
+    # Same base tensor in -> identical cache and view objects (no re-derivation).
+    cache2, conv_state2 = get_conv_state_view(cache, base)
+    assert cache2 is cache
+    assert conv_state2 is conv_state
+
+
+def test_rebuilds_when_tensor_replaced():
+    base_profiling = _base()
+    cache, cs_old = get_conv_state_view(None, base_profiling)
+    base_real = _base()
+    cache2, cs_new = get_conv_state_view(cache, base_real)
+    assert cache2[0] is base_real
+    assert cs_new is not cs_old
+
+
+def test_view_aliases_storage():
+    base = _base()
+    _, conv_state = get_conv_state_view(None, base)
+    # An in-place write through the cached (transposed) view must land in base,
+    # so the conv kernels keep reading/writing the real state cache.
+    conv_state.zero_()
+    assert torch.all(base == 0)
+
+
+def test_ds_layout_returns_base_unchanged():
+    base = _base()
+    with patch.object(mamba_utils, "is_conv_state_dim_first", return_value=True):
+        _, conv_state = get_conv_state_view(None, base)
+    # DS layout already stores (dim, state_len): no transpose, no copy.
+    assert conv_state is base

@@ -50,6 +50,33 @@ def is_conv_state_dim_first() -> bool:
     return get_conv_state_layout() == "DS"
 
 
+def get_conv_state_view(
+    cache: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None,
+    conv_state_base: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(new_cache, conv_state)`` for a mixer's conv-state cache tensor.
+
+    The conv kernels want ``(..., dim, state_len)``. DS layout stores it that
+    way; SD layout needs a ``transpose(-1, -2)``. That transpose depends only on
+    the cache tensor's storage/strides, which are fixed once the cache is
+    allocated, so re-deriving it on every forward is pure host overhead that
+    multiplies by num_mamba_layers x tokens on the eager (custom-op) path.
+
+    Cache the view per cache-tensor identity. The identity check rebuilds the
+    view when profiling's minimal state cache is replaced by the real one, so
+    the cache never points at freed memory. Mirrors the FlashAttention fix
+    #64571; part of the #59534 / #64572 per-call view-derivation class.
+    """
+    if cache is None or cache[0] is not conv_state_base:
+        view = (
+            conv_state_base
+            if is_conv_state_dim_first()
+            else conv_state_base.transpose(-1, -2)
+        )
+        cache = (conv_state_base, view)
+    return cache, cache[1]
+
